preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 100000 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of vertices in each test case is between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in zip(ns, edge_lists))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for n, edges in zip(ns, edge_lists) for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(k, int) and 0 <= k <= n - 2 for k in ks)
postconditions.description: The number of operations k for each test case is between 0 and n-2.

postconditions.expression: all(len(operations) == k for k, operations in zip(ks, operation_lists))
postconditions.description: The number of operations matches the specified k for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x1 <= n and 1 <= y1 <= n and 1 <= x2 <= n and 1 <= y2 <= n and x1 != y1 and x2 != y2 for n, operations in zip(ns, operation_lists) for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation specifies valid vertices within the range [1, n] and ensures x1 != y1 and x2 != y2.

postconditions.expression: all((x1, y1) in edges for n, edges, operations in zip(ns, edge_lists, operation_lists) for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: Each removed edge (x1, y1) is present in the original edges of the tree.

postconditions.expression: all((x2, y2) not in edges for n, edges, operations in zip(ns, edge_lists, operation_lists) for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: Each added edge (x2, y2) is not present in the original edges of the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(all(degree(v) <= 2 for v in range(1, n + 1)) for n, edges, operations in zip(ns, edge_lists, operation_lists))
postconditions.description: After performing the operations, no vertex has a degree greater than 2.
